**What would you like added?**
<!-- Company or fund name, and the ticker and exchange if you know them.
     A link to its Yahoo Finance page is the most useful thing of all. -->


**What can be added**

- Anything quoted in **sterling (pence or pounds) or US dollars** with a
  Yahoo Finance listing: shares, ETFs, investment trusts and UK funds.
- Other currencies cannot be displayed yet, so a foreign company goes in
  through its London or New York line where one exists - SK Hynix is
  listed as SKHY rather than its Seoul line, which quotes in won.
- One listing per company, so second share classes and currency-hedged
  twins of an ETF already on the site are not added.
- UK funds are identified by their Morningstar code, so an ISIN or a link
  to the exact share class saves a guess.

Requests are reviewed daily. Price history is backfilled automatically on
the next morning fetch, so a new instrument usually has five years of
chart within a day of being added.
